rules.title: Approval rules
rules.explain: A rule asks for approvals from chosen people or groups before a merge into its target branches.
rules.name: Name
rules.nameHelp: Lower-case letters, digits, "_", "." and "-". It cannot be renamed later.
rules.nameInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits, "_", "." and "-" (64 at most), starting with a letter or digit.
rules.targetHelp: A pattern such as refs/heads/main or refs/heads/release/*. Empty: every target branch.
rules.targetInvalid: Start with refs/heads/ and use at most one *, only in the last part.
rules.anyoneHelp: With no user and no group, anyone who may approve counts.

rules.nameTaken: A rule with this name exists. Change that rule in the list, or choose another name.

conditions.title: Merge conditions of protected branches
conditions.explain: What a merge into a protected branch needs. When several rules match a branch, the strictest of each applies.
conditions.none: No branch is protected. Protect a branch above to give it merge conditions.
conditions.workItem: A linked work item (PBI) is needed
conditions.workItemUnbound: This project is not connected to Kanflow, so no merge request can link a work item and every merge into this branch is blocked. Ask a maintainer to connect the project, or turn this condition off.
conditions.workItemDialog: Every merge into this branch needs a linked PBI. On a project not connected to Kanflow, nothing can link one, so every merge stops.
conditions.unreportable: No reporter can send some of the required checks, so every merge into this branch is blocked. Ask an administrator to let a service account report them, or remove those checks.
conditions.frozen: Direct pushes are forbidden too, so this branch cannot change at all.
conditions.countHelp: 0 to 20. The protected branch's own minimum.
conditions.checksHelp: Each starts with ci/, kanflow/ or forge/. 20 at most.
conditions.checksInvalid: Each check name starts with ci/, kanflow/ or forge/ and has no spaces (20 names at most).
conditions.saved: The merge conditions of {{pattern}} were saved.
conditions.removeBody: Merges into {{pattern}} will need only what the other rules ask for.
conditions.removed: The merge conditions of {{pattern}} were removed.

docLint.title: Document checks during a migration
docLint.intro: Broken references between documents are errors in the forge/doc-lint check. While documents are being moved into GitStation, you can treat them as warnings until a date. After that date they are errors again by themselves.
docLint.inForce: Migrating: broken references are warnings through the end of {{until}} in UTC (until {{local}} your time). After that they are errors again.
docLint.ended: The migration ended on {{until}}: broken references are errors again.
docLint.help: Required. From {{min}} to {{max}} (at most 180 days). A date lasts through the end of that day in UTC: {{day}} ends at {{local}} your time. Dates are the server's (today is {{today}}, UTC).
docLint.required: Enter the last day of the migration.
docLint.cleared: The migration ended: broken references are errors again.
docLint.readOnly: Only a Maintainer (or higher) can change this.

sa.disableBody: {{name}} stops working at once and all its tokens are revoked. It cannot be enabled again from this screen.
sa.isDisabled: {{name}} is disabled, so no token can be issued. Create a new service account for the same purpose, or ask the operator to enable it.
sa.usernameHelp: Letters, digits and dashes. It is also the path of its personal namespace and cannot be changed.
sa.displayNameHelp: Optional, up to 255 characters. The username is used when empty.
sa.displayNameLong: The display name is too long (255 characters at most).
sa.descriptionHelp: Why it exists, one line, up to 500 characters.
sa.purposeInvalid: Use one line of up to 500 characters.
sa.ownerHelp: You ({{name}}) will be the owner who answers for this account.
sa.noTokens: This account has no tokens yet.
sa.issueExplain: The secret is shown once, right after you press Issue token.
sa.scopesHelp: The admin scope is never given to a service account.
sa.grantsExplain: The projects where this account may report checks, and the namespace it may use.

actAs.leadUnapprove: {{app}} is trying to withdraw your approval of this merge request.

actAs.pressUnapprove: Check the details. If they are right, press "Withdraw approval". If not, press "Cancel".

integrations.unbindAgain: Binding it again is done from kanflow.
